Export conversation

Text, tables, sources, images, and files.

JEX automatically includes the note, images, attachments, and generated files. Joplin places the imported note in a notebook, usually Imported, because every Joplin note must belong to a notebook. The note follows Joplin’s active light or dark theme.

External media permission is only needed for images or files hosted outside ChatGPT, such as web-search and product images.
